userStories.title: Parallel workers: atomic compare-and-swap for prd.json updates in worker worktrees
userStories.description: Workers update their local WTREE/prd.json using jq read-modify-write cycles: read file -> modify in memory -> write tmp -> mv tmp to prd.json. When two sub-processes within the same worker (e.g. the main ralph loop and the retry handler) hit the same file concurrently, the second write overwrites the first silently. Introduce an atomic_patch_prd() shell function in lib/core/prd_lock.sh that: (1) acquires a per-WTREE lockfile (mkdir-based, PID recorded), (2) reads prd.json, (3) applies the jq transform passed as argument, (4) writes atomically (tmp+mv), (5) releases the lock.
